trace_certificate.definition: Concrete metadata trace record containing execution steps and compatibility flags.
trace_certificate.validation: Validated by trace checker in simulator.

formal_proof_term.definition: Formal Lean 4 proof term demonstrating derivation of the relation.

executable_witness_artifact.definition: Operational witness data generated during finite simulation run.

soundness_requirements: Soundness: For all realizations r and semantic witnesses w, if Realizes_C(r, w) holds and r is valid within its respective class, then w is a valid semantic witness (TypedWitness_C(w) is true).
completeness_status: Incomplete. Completeness (that every semantic witness has a concrete realization) is not assumed and remains generally false in infinite models.
cross_representation_equivalence_status: Intensional equivalence only. A trace certificate is structurally distinct from a Lean proof term, and they cannot be substituted for each other directly. They are equivalent only through their mapping to the same abstract semantic witness w.
